 Michelle Dee undergoes emergency appendectomy
 By Iza Iglesias
 November 19, 2026
 80
 Resize 
 Small 
 Medium 
 Large 
 MANILA, Philippines — Miss Universe Philippines 2023 Michelle Dee revealed that she underwent emergency appendectomy on Nov. 9 after experiencing sharp abdominal pain while on her way to work.
 Michelle Dee shares photos from her recent hospitalization after undergoing emergency appendectomy. PHOTOS FROM INSTAGRAM/MICHELLEDEE
 Dee shared details of her hospitalization and recovery in an Instagram post on Thursday, saying she had been feeling that something was not right with her body even before the incident.
 “Been holding back sharing the details of what happened to me last week, but here it is,” she wrote.

 “As November approached, I already felt that something wasn’t quite right with my body, and true enough, on November 9 I found myself in the emergency room after experiencing sharp stabbing pain in the lower right side of my abdomen while on my way to work,” she recounted.
 “What followed was an emergency appendectomy, my first ever hospital admission, three incisions to my abdomen, and yes, a major surgery I definitely wasn’t expecting. It was simply an impossible situation that was inevitably going to happen.”
 Advertisement 
 The beauty queen also shared photos documenting her hospital stay, including images of herself in a hospital bed, her abdominal incisions and a CT scan. One image showed a note stating that while the initial scan showed one stone, doctors found three after her appendix was removed.
 Dee thanked St. Luke's Medical Center for attending to her, saying the surgery went well and her recovery had been steady.
 While the initial scan showed one stone, doctors found three after Dee's appendix was removed.
 However, she emphasized that her medical team had advised her to strictly follow her recovery timeline and avoid strenuous physical activities.
 Advertisement 
 “I was advised by my medical team to strictly follow my recovery timeline. No prolonged strenuous abdominal activities. No heavy exertion. And most importantly, no pushing my body beyond what it can safely handle,” she said.
 “Rushing this particular recovery (as I’ve done in the past) could lead to long-term complications which I cannot afford.”
 The beauty queen also shared a message about facing life's challenges, writing, “Kilala niyo naman ako. Dapat buo, hindi kalahati ang mga laban sa buhay.” (You know me. I believe in giving everything in life, not doing things halfway.)
 Despite the unexpected health setback, Dee expressed gratitude for the support she received from her family, friends, fans and everyone who had been looking after her.
 Advertisement 
 “Despite everything though, I'm so blessed and grateful to have the right people around me. To my family, friends, fans, and everyone who’s been looking out for me, thank you. The smallest gestures have meant the world to me,” she said.
 She ended her message with, “All in God's time. Always in all ways.
 Before revealing the details of her surgery, Dee had hinted at experiencing health concerns in a Nov. 2 post on her Instagram broadcast channel.
 “Something really weird has been going on with my body lately. Just a little reminder to never ignore the signs your body gives you.,” she wrote. 
 Advertisement 
 Dee is expected to represent the Philippines in the upcoming Miss Grand International (MGI) All Stars competition in Bangkok, Thailand, with the coronation night scheduled for Dec. 12 at MGI Hall.
 However, it remains unclear whether she will be medically cleared to join the competition following her emergency surgery. Dee has yet to announce whether her recovery will affect her participation in the pageant.
